notes: New: Document viewer — open PDFs and images right inside Wingman, with fast smooth scrolling and mouse-wheel zoom
New: Search inside any document with Adobe-style highlighting — including text inside images and scans (on-device OCR, nothing leaves your machine)
New: Measure tool — click two points, type the real distance, and read off any measurement on floor plans and images
New: Area tool — draw an area to get its real square footage (m²/ft²) once a scale is set, or just to mark a zone
New: Print your marked-up documents — measurements and areas included
New: Call Quality analyzer — passively measures Teams / Zoom / Webex call quality (loss, jitter, MOS) and correlates it with your Wi-Fi and path, no admin rights needed
New: Live interface traffic monitor — real-time up/down throughput for any network adapter
New: Peripheral throughput meter — live Bluetooth and USB-storage data rates
New: Cisco Catalyst 9800 report — turn a "show tech-support wireless" capture into a branded report
Improved: branded one-click installer, a Get Started welcome, and sign-in with Google
Automatic updates: Wingman checks for and installs new versions on launch
Reliability: many stability and quality fixes across the document tools and live meters
